works.title: Selected Projects
works.subtitle: Projects designed and coded from scratch to solve practical bottlenecks in manufacturing, data verification, and mobile commerce.

cases.title: Dora MES — Textile Production Tracking
cases.summary: Web system built for a textile factory to replace paper tickets with real-time bundle tracking across cutting, sewing, and external workshops.
cases.bottleneck: 1,200-piece batches split into dozens of bundles that were hard to track on paper. Factory Wi-Fi also dropped frequently, and operators needed a fast, simple screen.
cases.solution: Next.js and Firestore web app with local offline caching (saves updates on the device when Wi-Fi drops) and real fabric yield calculation after cutting.

cases.title: Santos PREP — High-Speed Landing Page & Gazette Audit
cases.summary: Fast sales page for a civil-service exam prep course, backed by a Python script that verified real student approvals in Official Gazette PDFs.
cases.bottleneck: To build genuine trust with candidates, we needed to verify past approvals by cross-referencing student spreadsheets against hundreds of pages of Official Gazette PDFs.
cases.solution: Python script (PyPDF) to normalize names and match each call-up in public PDFs, paired with a lightweight static Next.js page that loads instantly on mobile 4G.

cases.title: Use Azevedo — Custom E-Commerce & Virtual Fitting
cases.summary: Custom online store for a plus-size women's fashion brand, featuring an integrated size recommender and a simple admin panel for inventory control.
cases.bottleneck: Static measurement charts cause hesitation on mobile phones and lead to size returns. The brand also needed to move away from slow rented platforms.
cases.solution: Next.js storefront backed by PostgreSQL, automated fit recommendation (bust, waist, and hips), custom product dashboard, and InfinitePay checkout integration.

trajectory.title: From the editing room to software and data.
trajectory.lead: Before moving into tech, I spent over 15 years directing and editing video. In the editing room, you learn how to cut what doesn't matter, organize complex information, and guide the viewer's attention.
trajectory.body: Today I apply that same mindset to software development and data analysis. I like understanding how an operation actually works on the ground — whether on a factory floor, in a backoffice routine, or on a customer's phone — and writing clean code that solves the problem without unnecessary complexity.
